inputs.checklistItemText: Non-utility-compatible trees proposed within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor or equipment
inputs.question: Are there any overhead electric distribution lines shown on the landscape plan (Sheet 31)? If yes, describe their location and extent on the site.

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a sheet-discovery and feature-presence check (does OHE appear on this landscape plan at all, and where?), which is a prerequisite to the actual 15-foot lateral clearance measurement.
